objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All remote action refs across both workflow files were pinned — including the release.yaml file with a non-standard extension the agent had to discover, and both jobs in ci.yml — leaving only the correctly-excluded local and docker refs.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent correctly left the local action and docker reference unpinned, touched no unrelated files, and deliberately kept each action on its existing major version rather than bumping to new majors.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: The agent clearly listed every ref changed, noted the SHAs are full 40-char dereferenced hashes satisfying the cooling-off period, and confirmed YAML validity, though it asserts rather than shows the concrete verification steps.
